args.root_cause: Overworld chunk (1,0) in world/region/r.0.0.mca (blocks x16-31, z0-15, directly adjacent to spawn where both players were) became unreadable: zlib "incorrect header check" on decompression. The region file was rewritten at 08:26:45 during an unclean shutdown/crash of the first server process (console.out shows no "Stopping server" line before the second "Starting org.bukkit.craftbukkit.Main"; log rotated to logs/2026-11-01-1.log.gz). On the following startup Paper logged ChunkDataTask/ChunkLoadTask failures for world (1,0) with "chunk data will be lost", meaning it would regenerate the chunk blank and overwrite the players' builds on the next save. The chunk was clean at my baseline inspection; all other region files (overworld r.-1.-1, r.-1.0, r.0.-1; nether r.0.0; end r.0.0) were unaffected. I could not determine what triggered the unplanned restart itself from the available logs.
args.actions: 1) Baseline: status, logs, fs listing, mca inspect of all 4 overworld region files (0 corrupt), noted backups/world-2026-10-31. 2) After ~60s, log grep showed ERROR "Failed to read chunk data ... world (1,0)" following an unexpected server restart at 08:26:45; re-inspected world/region/r.0.0.mca -> chunk 1,0 corrupt. 3) Declared incident. 4) Verified backups/world-2026-10-31/region/r.0.0.mca chunk 1,0 is ok (saved 05:50:04, ~25s older than live neighbours); read console.out to confirm the prior process ended uncleanly. 5) Stopped the server (required for copy_chunk; world saved). 6) mca copy_chunk 1,0 from backups/world-2026-10-31/region/r.0.0.mca into world/region/r.0.0.mca. 7) Inspected world/region/r.0.0.mca (400 chunks, 0 corrupt, chunk 1,0 ok) plus nether/end r.0.0 (0 corrupt). 8) Started the server. 9) Verified: status UP, TPS 20, both players rejoined, all 5 plugins enabled, no chunk errors in the new log. 10) Ran console save-all, then re-inspected r.0.0.mca: chunk 1,0 reloaded by Paper and re-saved cleanly at 08:29:30, 0 corrupt. 11) Watched a further ~75s: stable, no recurrence, no further unplanned restarts (only two log rotations: 08:26:45 unexpected, 08:28:20 mine). No files deleted, no configs changed, no players banned.
args.residual_risk: Chunk (1,0) was restored from the 2026-10-31 backup record (saved 05:50:04); any block changes made in that single chunk between 05:50:04 and the corruption at 08:26:45 (live neighbours were last saved 05:50:29-30, so a ~25s window) are lost, as is anything players did in the briefly-regenerated blank chunk between 08:26:50 and my stop at ~08:27:59. The underlying trigger of the unclean shutdown at 08:26:45 was not identifiable from logs/console.out; if it recurs, further partial-write corruption is possible. Recommend the team check the host/process supervisor for the cause of that crash and take a fresh full backup now that the world is clean. Players were disconnected once by my stop/start (~25s).
